item.title: Ransomware attack knocks German hospital network offline
item.description: A regional hospital network in Germany has gone offline after a ransomware attack. Appointments have been postponed and investigators are examining how the attackers got in.

item.title: New smartphone launches with a bigger battery
item.description: The latest handset adds a bigger battery and a brighter display.

item.title: Retailer in India leaks customer phone numbers & addresses in data breach
item.description: Customer records of an Indian online retailer were exposed on an open database. The company has locked the database and is informing users.
